== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Perfected]] are a specialized group of individuals, often described as abominations, who are created through intense research and horrific processes. Their creation involves sacrificing hundreds or even thousands of people to harvest their genetics and power, serving as templates for new members. This process has a low survival rate and requires significant resources, including alchemical reagents, magical rituals, and lives. While they are often viewed as a blight on the galaxy, they are highly competent and pose a significant threat to [[Union]] intelligence. Physically, Perfected differ from natural [[Karoshan|Karoshans]]; they are typically slimmer but possess more effective musculature, making them faster and stronger. Some variations include long reptilian tails, navy-colored skin, and neon blue hair-cables. They are highly skilled in various roles, such as snipers, marksmen, duelists, and gunners. They utilize advanced [[Aethertech]], including personal shields and specialized weaponry, and are capable of wielding powerful combat arts. [[The Perfected]] operate from outposts and dreadnoughts, such as the [[Dragon’s Edge|Dragon's Edge]], and have been known to research subspace biology to further their own self-improvement. Their ultimate goals have included attempting to create an [[Iron King]].}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[The Perfected]] are a specific type of [[Karoshan]] distinguished by their long reptilian tails and teeth that are sharper than those of the average member of their species. Historically, they were among the various groups encountered by [[Starhammer]] during his era of conquest. In more recent rumors, it is suggested that one of the [[King Regent]]'s ships is commanded by a member of this group. Though they view battlefields as mere playgrounds, the crew remains unprepared for an eventual showdown against them, even as they follow [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] to oppose this enemy.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[The Perfected]] was one of the groups [[Starhammer]] fought during his conquest.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c7">''The Engineer'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The crew is not yet prepared for a showdown against [[The Perfected|the Perfected]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c19">''The Engineer'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Rumor states the [[King Regent]]'s ships are led by one of his [[Perfected]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c33">''The Engineer'', chapter 33</ref>}}</li>

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[The Perfected]] are an army being built by [[King Regent|King Regent Felrex]] through [[Karoshan]] genetic engineering research. This creation process involves sacrificing hundreds or thousands of [[Karoshan|Karoshans]] and carries a low survival rate, resulting in individuals who possess a single suicide agent. Associated with [[Felrex]] and [[Karosha]], this group is considered one of the true enemies and is expected to arrive from their home planet with a fleet of black ships. Having previously made a bid for control of the galaxy, a Perfected fleet was even permitted to pass through a gap in [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]]'s blockade. They are also identified as a potential group responsible for subspace blockades.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Perfected]] are an artificially created subspecies that functions as a ruling caste and is described as a blight on the galaxy. Led by [[King Regent|King Regent Felrex]], this group becomes a target for [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]], who aims to crush their outposts and eliminate their members. During these conflicts, the [[Zenith Cannon]] is utilized against one of the group. Following these events, [[Benri Vallenar]] is assigned to continue research into [[The Perfected|the Perfected]], even as threats emerge that might approach them directly. Despite being enemies of [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]]'s resources, the status of being Perfected provides individuals with increased ability and the means to gather support.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Perfected]] are a group led by [[King Regent|King Regent Felrex]] described as a blight on the galaxy.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c16">''The Pilot'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]]'s target involves crushing a [[Perfected]] outpost and killing any [[Perfected]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c19">''The Pilot'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith Cannon]] settled for one of [[The Perfected|the Perfected]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c23">''The Pilot'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Perfected]] are an artificially created subspecies that serves as a ruling caste.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c27">''The Pilot'', chapter 27</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The enemy might approach [[The Perfected|the Perfected]] directly.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c35">''The Pilot'', chapter 35</ref>}}</li>
